versions.intro: All versions of {{name}}, newest first. Only the adopted version is used by the next step.

prompt.compiled: Compiled layer (edit directly; it stops following the intent)

modeHint.api: Calls the API; billed per call.

picker.noLocal: This component has no model that runs locally.

line.keyframes_redraw: {{count}} keyframes ({{shots}} shots) must be redrawn for the new aspect
